在英国，孩子身边有一位真正认识他的人。

One guardian who knows your child — from the first meeting to the last day of term.

易扬教育是服务于伦敦外车程1小时左右的东南地区（萨里郡、伯克郡与汉普郡）的独立教育规划和监护服务机构，照顾就读英国寄宿学校的国际学生。与您初次见面的人，就是照顾您孩子的人。为学生在英国升学就业做长远规划。

Yiyang Education is an independent education planning and guardianship service covering South East England — Surrey, Berkshire and Hampshire, about an hour from London — caring for international students at UK boarding schools. The person who meets your family is the person who looks after your child, and we plan for each student's long-term education and career in the UK.

Weekend and half-term homestays, airport transfers and travel escorts, plus summer and winter camps and UK independent school immersion — with Yiyang providing local guardianship throughout.

About us

关于易扬

易扬教育监护服务英国萨里郡、伯克郡与汉普郡，为就读英国寄宿学校的国际学生提供教育监护与照顾服务。我们是独立监护人机构：与您初次见面的人，就是照顾您孩子的人。

Yiyang Education & Guardianship is an educational guardianship service covering Surrey, Berkshire and Hampshire, providing guardianship and care for international students attending boarding schools in the United Kingdom. We are a sole guardian practice: the person who meets your family is the person who looks after your child.
